from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT/'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results/gate-rejection-followup-20261102'
author_path = OUT/'crossrepo-repair.json'
author = json.loads(author_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
expected = author['delivery_files_sha256']
before = {p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in expected}
assert before == expected
wip = {p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in author['rf_four_wip_before']}
assert wip == author['rf_four_wip_before']
sys.path[:0] = ['C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/revenue-forecast/scripts',
               'C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/invest-skills/invest-core/scripts']
from forecast import calc
import invest_contracts
assert Path(calc.__file__).resolve() == Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/revenue-forecast/scripts/forecast/calc.py').resolve()
assert Path(invest_contracts.__file__).resolve() == Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/invest-skills/invest-core/scripts/invest_contracts.py').resolve()
records = []
started = time.perf_counter()
for name, owner, entry_name in [('RF',calc,'evaluate_derived_formula'),('invest',invest_contracts,'evaluate_formula')]:
    entry = getattr(owner,entry_name)
    expression = '+'.join(['x0/(1+x1)**2']*48)+'-x2'
    expanded = expression.replace('+',' +'+' '*25).replace('-',' -'+' '*25)
    economic_expected = 48*120/(1.1**2)-1000
    for label, formula in [('long_economic',expression),('whitespace_equivalent',expanded)]:
        actual=entry(formula,[120,0.1,1000])
        assert len(formula)>500 and math.isclose(actual,economic_expected,rel_tol=1e-12)
        records.append(dict(owner=name,case=label,length=len(formula),actual=actual,expected=economic_expected,status='PASS'))
    measure = owner.FormulaWorkBudget()
    assert entry('x0+1',[2],work_budget=measure) == 3
    budget = owner.FormulaWorkBudget(max_work_units=measure.work_units)
    assert entry('x0+1',[2],work_budget=budget) == 3
    parse_calls=[]
    actual_parse=owner.ast.parse
    def observed_parse(*args,**kwargs):
        parse_calls.append(True)
        return actual_parse(*args,**kwargs)
    with patch.object(owner.ast,'parse',observed_parse):
        for formula in ('x0','1'):
            try:
                entry(formula,[2],work_budget=budget)
            except ValueError as exc:
                assert 'work budget' in str(exc)
            else:
                raise AssertionError('depleted shared account must not restart')
    assert not parse_calls and budget.work_units > budget.max_work_units
    records.append(dict(owner=name,case='shared_account_exhaustion_stops_before_parse',limit=budget.max_work_units,
                        work_units=budget.work_units,post_exhaustion_parse_calls=len(parse_calls),status='PASS'))
    # Multiple real numeric/AST failure paths, not a formula-character oracle.
    bad = [('unknown_variable','missing+1',[2]), ('call','sum([x0])',[2]),
           ('division_zero','x0/(x1-x1)',[2,3]), ('pow_range','x0**11',[2]),
           ('pow_overflow','x0**10',[1e308]), ('nonfinite_literal','1e309',[]),
           ('nonfinite_input','x0',[float('inf')]), ('bool_literal','True',[])]
    errors=[]
    for label,formula,inputs in bad:
        try:
            entry(formula,inputs)
        except ValueError as exc:
            errors.append(dict(case=label,type=type(exc).__name__,error=str(exc)))
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f'{name} accepted {label}')
    records.append(dict(owner=name,case='numeric_and_illegal_ast_controls',details=errors,status='PASS'))
    actual=entry('x0-x1-x2+x3/(1+x4)**2',[100,5,2,121,0.1])
    assert math.isclose(actual,193.0,rel_tol=1e-12)
    records.append(dict(owner=name,case='left_right_economic_order',actual=actual,expected=193.0,status='PASS'))
    for kind in (RecursionError,MemoryError):
        with patch.object(owner.ast,'parse',side_effect=kind('synthetic parser capacity')):
            try:
                entry('x0+1',[2])
            except ValueError as exc:
                assert 'parser capacity' in str(exc)
            else:
                raise AssertionError('actual parser capacity must not be hidden')
    records.append(dict(owner=name,case='actual_parser_capacity_is_named',status='PASS'))

after = {p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in expected}
wip_after={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in wip}
assert before==after==expected and wip==wip_after
result = dict(status='PASS',author_report_sha256=hashlib.sha256(author_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              source_before=before,source_after=after,rf_wip_before=wip,rf_wip_after=wip_after,
              canonical_loaded_modules={'RF':calc.__file__,'invest':invest_contracts.__file__},
              elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,records=records,
              no_repeat_author_groups=True,paid=0,network=0,originals=0)
(Path(__file__).parent/'observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'contracts':len(records),'elapsed_seconds':result['elapsed_seconds']}))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT=ROOT/'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results/gate-rejection-followup-20261102'
author=json.loads((OUT/'crossrepo-repair.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
before={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in author['delivery_files_sha256']}
assert before==author['delivery_files_sha256']
sys.path[:0]=['C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/revenue-forecast/scripts',
             'C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/invest-skills/invest-core/scripts']
from forecast.calc import evaluate_derived_formula
from invest_contracts import evaluate_formula
rows=[]
for owner,entry in [('RF',evaluate_derived_formula),('invest',evaluate_formula)]:
    for label,formula,inputs,expected in [
        ('fifteen_year_discount','x0/(1+x1)**x2',[100,0.05,15],100/(1.05**15)),
        ('finite_eleventh_power','x0**x1',[2,11],2048.0),
    ]:
        try:
            actual=entry(formula,inputs)
            rows.append(dict(owner=owner,case=label,formula=formula,inputs=inputs,expected=expected,actual=actual,status='ACCEPTED'))
        except ValueError as exc:
            rows.append(dict(owner=owner,case=label,formula=formula,inputs=inputs,expected=expected,error=str(exc),status='LEGAL_MATH_REFUSED'))
after={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before}
assert before==after
result=dict(finding='P2-MATH-EXPONENT-10',rows=rows,sources_before=before,sources_after=after)
(Path(__file__).parent/'pow-observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
